facts.text: Harris County auditor memo, June 2025: by March 2025, 43 of 181 bond project groups in the 2018 flood bond program were complete.
Flood bond project information is published by Harris County Precinct 4.

In September 2025 the county restructured the 2018 bond program: of 116 remaining project packages, 75 are moving forward, 26 are paused and 15 were closed as not feasible; 54 packages were already complete. Check the HCFCD dashboard for current status.

Construction of Linear Detention on Buffalo Bayou
Rehabilitation of Channels Upstream of Addicks Reservoir to Restore Channel Conveyance Capacity

facts.text: Addicks and Barker reservoirs date from the 1940s. Since 2004 the Army Corps of Engineers has found a high risk of failure due to seepage and piping; more than $100M in repairs were needed, and not all are complete.
5,138 of about 14,000 homes inside the reservoirs flooded in Harvey; at least 4,000 were built after Allison.
Reservoir releases during Harvey flooded thousands more homes downstream.

As of 2017 ProPublica reporting, Harris County and Houston did not require flood-risk disclosure to buyers. Texas law has since added a landlord flood notice (Property Code 92.0135, since 2022) and a seller's disclosure of floodplain and reservoir status (SB 339, 2019).
